name: motif_start_proposal
description:
Start a Proposal. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Start one small Proposal per grammar question, then try it before anything else (guide workflow). Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Set a short label and a Rationale before Finalize, then measure and revise the Draft. Only a person can Apply.
Command: new. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Label: The short description a person reads while reviewing the Proposal.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

rationale.description: What this Proposal changes and why, in Markdown: the evidence, in a few sentences.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_natural_class
description:
Author a natural class. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

abbreviation.description: Unique environment abbreviation, such as V.

members.description: Phoneme ids in the first set.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the phonological feature system.

value.description: Symbolic value belonging to that feature.

features.description: Closed phonological feature/value pairs; copy ids from motif_grammar.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_natural_class
description:
Edit a natural class. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation). Adds or removes phonemes from one existing segment natural class after checking its exact current members. The response lists rules, environments and insertions that still use the class. name: motif_add_phonological_rule
description:
Author a phonological rule. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for a regular sound change across many forms. Not for one irregular word: use an alternate form or allomorph (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one simple rewrite rule in a Draft, using existing phonemes and natural classes with explicit context and rule placement. Empty input or output means insertion or deletion; unsupported alpha variables and metathesis are refused. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-rule. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

name: motif_add_affix_slot
description:
Author an affix slot. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a named inflectional affix slot owned by an existing category and can assign existing inflectional affixes to it in the same Draft. Inspect its Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-slot. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the new slot.

name.description: Slot name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the slot name.

optional.description: Whether forms may omit this slot.

assignments.description: Optional canonical ids of existing inflectional affix MSAs to assign.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_affix_template
description:
Author an affix template. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages an active alternative template on an existing category, using ordered prefix and suffix slots that belong to the category or an ancestor. It preserves existing template order and records whether this template requires further derivation. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-affix-template. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

category.description: Canonical id of the existing category that owns the template.

name.description: Template name in the project's writing system.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the template name.

prefix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of prefix slots.

suffix_slots.description: Ordered canonical ids of suffix slots.

final.description: Whether the template requires further derivation.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_retire_allomorph
description:
Retire or merge forms. Research first: motif_guide topic no-inflection; check best practice. Retires listed forms and moves their references. Retire only a redundant form, and check every affected approved word in a Trial (guide no-inflection). Stages one connected Proposal to retire ordinary prefix or suffix alternates after their references move; the sound-rule form also stages its natural class and rule. Dry Run shows bundle Morph and copied Form text changes, other references, and deletion together. Missing destinations are refused with counts for distinct unresolved Approved analyses, ad hoc rules, and other references; only a person can Apply.
Command: retire-allomorph. Agent class: Draft.

intent_json.description: Closed motif-retire-allomorph/v1 JSON with exact source, destination and reference identities.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_adhoc_prohibition
description:
Edit an ad hoc prohibition. Research first: motif_guide topic ask-the-linguist or suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Only disables or enables an existing prohibition. Prefer a slot, template, feature or environment that removes the need (guides suffix-prefix-slots, feature-conditioned-slots). Stages one explicit Disabled value for a flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition in a Draft. The expected value guards against stale evidence; Motif never Applies this change automatically. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of one flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition.

expected_disabled.description: The value the target must currently have.

disabled.description: The explicit Disabled value to write.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_inflectional_affix
description:
Edit an inflectional affix. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. name: motif_edit_allomorph_condition
description:
Edit an allomorph condition. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Changes the environment references on one existing stem or affix allomorph after checking its current list. Shared environments remain unchanged for every other allomorph that uses them. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-allomorph-condition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing stem or affix allomorph.

expectedEnvironments.description: Current environment ids; order matters only for position.

environments.description: Requested environment ids; order matters only for position.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_order_allomorphs
description:
Order alternate forms. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Changes the order of existing alternate forms within one entry after checking their current order. The lexeme form cannot be moved, and Motif stages the moves in a Draft for human review. Only a person can Apply.
Command: order-allomorphs. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the owning lexical entry.

expectedAlternates.description: Current alternate-form ids in project order.

alternates.description: Requested order of those same alternate forms.

name: motif_parsimony_record_types
description:
List Notebook record types. Lists the saved Notebook record types with their portable IDs and readable names. Use the ID when you stage a Parsimony disposition.
Command: parsimony record-types. Agent class: Read.

name: motif_dispose_parsimony_finding
description:
Stage a finding disposition. Stages a keep, fix, ask, or defer decision from one finding in a stored Parsimony Report. It derives the exact subject and evidence from that finding and appends the existing Notebook operations to a Draft Proposal. Only a person can Apply.
Command: parsimony dispose. Agent class: Draft.
ReportId: The exact stored Parsimony report identity.
FindingId: The exact finding identity within that report.
Disposition: The advisory disposition to record for the finding.
RecordTypeId: The project's Notebook record type for the advisory record.
DraftName: The mutable Draft receiving the semantic intent.
Reason: The person's reason for the advisory disposition, when supplied.
Question: The question to retain for later review, when supplied.

report_id.description: Id of a stored Parsimony Report from this project.

finding_id.description: Exact finding id returned by that Report.

reason.description: Optional explanation, stored with the readable record.

question.description: Required only when disposition is ask.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_dry_run
description:
Dry Run a Proposal. Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
Command: dry-run. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
Read a Dry Run. Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.
Command: dry-run --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
JobId: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
Timeout: The maximum wait for a result before returning progress.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_finalize_proposal
description:
Finalize a Proposal. Finalizes a Draft as an immutable Proposal revision for a person to review. The Draft needs both a short label and a Rationale. Evidence for unchanged content on the same Baseline remains current.
Command: finalize. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
ExpectedRevision: The required Draft revision for this write.

expected_revision.description: The revision you last read, to refuse if the draft changed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_parsimony_measures
description:
List Parsimony measures. Lists registered grammar checks, their axes, evidence tiers, citations, and fixed views. It reads the catalog without invoking PanGloss.
Command: parsimony measures. Agent class: Read.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_run_parsimony_measure
description:
Review grammar parsimony. Runs a registered Parsimony measure, or every measure with --measure all, over the current Baseline, or compares a completed Proposal Dry Run against that Baseline. Candidate evidence uses a private copy and stores before and after Reports. Use parsimony measures to list checks and their evidence needs.
Command: parsimony. Agent class: Evaluate.
MeasureId: The registered Parsimony measure to run.
EvidenceScope: The declared source of word evidence for the measure.
AssessmentIds: The exact retained Assessments supplying evidence, when supplied.
Wait for a Parsimony Report. Queues the requested Parsimony measure and waits for its stored Report. It does not capture a Baseline or require an Assessment.
Command: parsimony --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
JobId: The queued job whose result to read.
Timeout: The maximum wait for this call; the job continues after the wait ends.
Run every Parsimony measure. Runs every Parsimony measure this build supports in one job over one verified evidence bundle, then waits and returns one stored Report per measure. It does not capture a Baseline or require an Assessment.
Command: parsimony --measure all --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
JobId: The queued job whose Reports to read.
Timeout: The maximum wait for this call; the job continues after the wait ends.

measure_id.description: Exact registered measure id, or 'all' to run every supported measure in one job and read one Report per measure.

job.description: Job id from a previous running result; omit to start a new measure.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a result. Default 40.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
